title: The Impossible Number That Exposed Madoff
title_alternatives: How Simple Math Caught 3 Massive Frauds
3 Frauds That Needed More Than the World Had
The Math That Exposes Every Ponzi Scheme
description:
In 1991 Bernie Madoff claimed 123 call options. Only 20 changed hands that day. The impossible number behind Madoff, Ponzi and the Salad Oil Swindle.

Charles Ponzi, Tino De Angelis and Bernie Madoff each claimed more than existed. Madoff's claims went unchallenged for years, even after analyst Harry Markopolos took his math to the SEC. The video ends with a three-question test for spotting the next one.
